destination.title: AdS compactifications: scale hierarchies, control and holographic tests
destination.question: Which compactifications admit controlled AdS scale hierarchies, how robust are their effective descriptions, and what can spectra, dual theories and consistency tests establish about them?
destination.summary: This is a proposed organizing family. Construction, localization, stabilization, spectra and duality provide related but independently scoped questions. The original numerical membership supplies no prose scope to assess verbatim; its scientific usefulness depends on retaining these distinctions and routing unrelated vacuum questions to alternate homes.

systems: Type IIA and IIB flux compactifications
Type I, heterotic and M-theory settings where explicitly described
Freund–Rubin dual pairs and proposed boundary theories
targets: Controlled reductions, source localization and geometric resolution
Retained moduli, vacuum stability and candidate uplift mechanisms
Bulk spectra, conformal data and possible dual descriptions
regimes: AdS2, AdS3 and AdS4 where explicitly specified
Weak-coupling limits and separately identified strong-coupling alternatives
No-scale Minkowski and proposed dS uplift branches as related applications
assumptions: Control, localization and stabilization are questions to assess, not shared established premises.
Each construction retains its own flux, source, truncation and quantization restrictions.
A putative dual CFT is not an identified dual theory.
conventions: KK/AdS separation, a heavy lightest scalar and a Wilsonian cutoff hierarchy are different notions.
Supersymmetry of an effective action does not specify supersymmetry of each vacuum.
Exact classical integer dimensions and asymptotically integer dimensions remain distinct.
Source dates and pre-result statements retain their original temporal scope.
includes: Ordinary and early flux-vacuum work without requiring a Swampland framing
AdS2 as a dimension-specific extension with its own effective-theory limitations
Twisted compactifications, maximal truncations and topological holography as qualified methodological neighbors
excludes: Pure SU(3) Yang–Mills metastability as a direct compactification question
Stand-alone third-way gravity as evidence for string compactification control
Universal consistency, full string stability or complete dual constructions inferred from abstracts or bounded excerpts

sources.title: Runaway in the Landscape

evidence.text: Do anisotropic bulk solutions obey the same mass scaling, and can strong-coupling flux vacua be described by a tractable dual gauge theory? A separate unresolved task is to compute the correction coefficients that decide whether the proposed stabilization and uplift mechanisms work.

sources.title: Dual Purpose Landscaping Tools: Small Extra Dimensions in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can known Freund-Rubin dual pairs be modified to stabilize internal dimensions parametrically smaller than the AdS radius, while retaining a concrete brane definition of the dual field theory?

sources.title: No-scale and scale-separated flux vacua from IIA on G2 orientifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIA flux compactification on G₂ orientifolds provide a three-dimensional effective supergravity with no-scale Minkowski vacua and classically stabilized AdS₃ vacua whose KK and AdS scales separate parametrically at weak coupling and large volume?

sources.title: Scale-separated AdS4 vacua of IIA orientifolds and M-theory

evidence.text: Can fixed-charge orientifold compactifications yield parametrically scale-separated AdS4 vacua without Romans mass, with controlled localization at weak or strong IIA coupling, and a meaningful source-free eleven-dimensional lift?

sources.title: Aspects of type IIA AdS4 orientifold vacua

evidence.text: Which classical type IIA orientifold extrema are stable vacua, and which admit controlled ten-dimensional realizations with separated compactification and AdS scales?

sources.title: Aspects of type IIA AdS4 orientifold vacua

evidence.text: Which supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric type IIA AdS4 orientifold flux vacua arise, and how do stability, scale separation, localized ten-dimensional uplift and membrane decay constrain them?

sources.title: Adding fluxes to consistent truncations: IIB supergravity on AdS$_{3}$× S$^{3}$× S$^{3}$× S$^{1}$

evidence.text: How can additional flux produce a consistent maximal three-dimensional truncation containing the IIB AdS3 × S3 × S3 × S1 vacuum, and what does its uplift reveal about deformations, stability and global moduli?

sources.title: Type II orientifold flux vacua in 3D

evidence.text: Which half-maximal 3D gauged supergravities arise from type II orientifold flux reductions, and can their non-supersymmetric IIB AdS3 vacua combine perturbative stability, parametrically controlled scale separation and integer scalar-dual conformal dimensions?

sources.title: Integer dual dimensions in scale-separated AdS$_{3}$ from massive IIA

evidence.text: Which massive-IIA G2-orientifold flux choices yield scale-separated supersymmetric AdS3 vacua with integer limiting dimensions for dual scalar operators, and can this behavior coexist with stabilization of all retained moduli?

sources.title: On type IIB AdS33 flux vacua with scale separation and integer conformal dimensions

evidence.text: Can classical type IIB AdS3 orientifold vacua combine weak coupling, large internal volume, quantized fluxes, fixed source tadpoles, parametric scale separation and integer dimensions for would-be dual CFT2 operators?

sources.title: T-dualities and scale-separated AdS$_{3}$ in type I

evidence.text: Can three T-dualities and additional flux-scaling freedom produce parametrically controlled, scale-separated N=1 AdS3 vacua in type I, including stabilized bulk moduli and integer or asymptotically integer dual conformal dimensions?

sources.title: Classical scale-separated AdS$_3$ vacua in heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can heterotic compactifications produce supersymmetric AdS3 vacua with quantized fluxes, stabilized geometric moduli, weak coupling, large internal volume and parametric separation between internal and AdS length scales?

sources.title: G2 resolutions and backtracking in scale-separated AdS$_3$

evidence.text: Can massive-IIA scale-separated AdS3 vacua survive resolution of a Joyce G2 orbifold, including stabilization of exceptional geometric moduli, removal of orientifold intersections, consistent tadpoles, and a decoupling brane interpretation?

sources.title: Runaway in the Landscape

evidence.text: Reduce a coupled holomorphic and Kähler-covariant system by eliminating the field that enters W linearly. Solve the remaining equation, then impose physical imaginary parts and integer tadpole constraints. Minkowski solutions must be treated separately because the AdS reduction divides by nonzero polynomials.

sources.title: Dual Purpose Landscaping Tools: Small Extra Dimensions in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Estimate stabilization through a dimensionally reduced Einstein-frame potential: positive internal curvature contributes negative potential energy, 7-branes offset it with the same inverse-length-squared scaling, and metric flux plus five-form flux complete the balance. F theory handles the strong 7-brane backreaction.

sources.title: No-scale and scale-separated flux vacua from IIA on G2 orientifolds

evidence.text: Use G₂-form identities and representation projectors, enforce unit volume with a superfield Lagrange multiplier, and solve critical-point equations for P or V. Numerical critical points and noncanonically normalized Hessians diagnose stabilization in the retained scalar sector.

sources.title: Scale-separated AdS4 vacua of IIA orientifolds and M-theory

evidence.text: Laplacian eigenmodes estimate KK masses on twisted tori. The localized solution is lifted using ds11²=T^(2/3)ds10²+T^(−4/3)(dz+C1)², followed by an explicit curvature analysis.

sources.title: Aspects of type IIA AdS4 orientifold vacua

evidence.text: Perturb ten-dimensional equations around the smeared SUSY solution using SU(3)×SU(3) structure, retaining the first localization-sensitive order.

sources.title: Adding fluxes to consistent truncations: IIB supergravity on AdS$_{3}$× S$^{3}$× S$^{3}$× S$^{1}$

evidence.text: For the flat deformations, compute the KK spectrum by replacing circle momentum with a charge-dependent shifted momentum, multiplied by e⁻ψ. Supersymmetry enhancement is detected through gravitini attaining conformal dimension Δ=3/2.

sources.title: Integer conformal dimensions for type IIa flux vacua

evidence.text: Why do scalar operators dual to moduli in supersymmetric DGKT AdS4 flux vacua have integer, highly degenerate conformal dimensions, and does this universality extend to general Calabi–Yau orientifolds independently of fluxes and intersection numbers?

sources.title: Noninteger conformal dimensions for type IIA flux vacua

evidence.text: Are conformal dimensions of low-lying scalar operators dual to moduli necessarily integers in nonsupersymmetric DGKT vacua, and what do two general Calabi–Yau orientifold branches imply for their putative holographic descriptions?

sources.title: On supersymmetric AdS$_{4}$ orientifold vacua

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric massive-IIA backgrounds with localized orientifolds reproduce the defining integrated data of DGKT vacua? The aim is an initial ten-dimensional test of the proposal, motivated by its potential scale separation and tension with the Strong AdS Distance Conjecture.

sources.title: Scale-Separated AdS3 Vacua from G2-Orientifolds Using Bispinors

evidence.text: Can minimally supersymmetric type-II AdS3 orientifold vacua with G2 structure, their scale-separation conditions and their three-dimensional superpotential be obtained directly through bispinor equations?

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Can localized codimension-three orientifold sources replace the uniform source densities used in DGKT flux vacua while retaining a controlled four-dimensional AdS effective theory?

sources.title: Comments on classical AdS flux vacua with scale separation

evidence.text: Which light fields and higher-form potentials survive the singular G2 orbifold and O2/O6 projections used to obtain AdS3 vacua?

sources.title: Gromov-Witten/Hilbert versus AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$ correspondence

evidence.text: Can the GW/Hilbert correspondence geometrize the blow-up deformation of the symmetric-product boundary theory, organize its genus expansion beyond the orbifold point, and constrain scale separation in a topological AdS3/CFT2 setting?

sources.title: Supersymmetric scale-separated AdS$_{3}$ orientifold vacua of type IIB

evidence.text: Can classical type IIB compactifications yield minimally supersymmetric AdS3 vacua with stabilized geometric scalars, weak coupling, large internal radii and parametric separation between the AdS and KK scales?

sources.title: Comments on classical AdS flux vacua with scale separation

evidence.text: Are the integer scalar dimensions of the original DGKT orbifold special to its simple volume polynomial and exchange symmetry?

sources.title: Consistency conditions for O-plane unsmearing from second-order perturbation theory

evidence.text: Do second-order equations obstruct perturbative localization of O-planes in DGKT-type scale-separated AdS vacua through integral consistency conditions invisible at first order?

sources.title: Taxonomy of type II orientifold flux vacua in 3D

evidence.text: How common are weakly coupled, scale-separated AdS3 vacua among geometric type II twisted-torus orientifold reductions with one spacetime-filling Op-plane type, SO(3) invariance and vanishing axion VEVs?

sources.title: AdS$_{4}$ compactifications of AdS$_{7}$ solutions in type II supergravity

evidence.text: Can localized-source AdS7 solutions of massive IIA yield supersymmetric AdS4 compactifications through a twist over a compact three-manifold, and can the construction produce more general regular or sourced vacua?

sources.title: On the Conformal Field Theory Duals of type IIA AdS(4) Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: What central-charge scaling, operator spectrum, symmetries, and approximate moduli-space geometry must a three-dimensional CFT dual to the studied type IIA AdS4 flux compactifications reproduce?

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: Can consistency of three-dimensional CFTs exclude AdS₄ vacua with a parametrically heavy lightest scalar? The proposed investigation concerns theories without relevant deformations, with strongly coupled possibilities explicitly unresolved.

sources.title: Scale-separated AdS$_3\times $S$^1$ vacua from IIA orientifolds

evidence.text: Can anisotropic supersymmetric massive-IIA flux vacua produce an effectively four-dimensional AdS3×S1 exterior separated from six smaller directions, while retaining weak coupling and large internal radii, and how do these vacua interpolate to fully scale-separated AdS3?

sources.title: A note on O6 intersections in AdS flux vacua

evidence.text: Must O6-planes intersect in DGKT-CFI AdS flux compactifications, or can resolving toroidal orbifolds remove intersections and the associated proposed obstruction to consistency?

sources.title: Holographic perspectives on models of moduli stabilization in M-theory

evidence.text: What operator dimensions would an assumed dual CFT3 assign to moduli and axions in supersymmetric M-theory AdS vacua stabilized by fluxes or by nonperturbative effects?

sources.title: Comments on classical AdS flux vacua with scale separation

evidence.text: Do the scale-separated effective vacua survive localized orientifold backreaction and corrections beyond classical supergravity?

sources.title: Scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can classical massive Type IIA compactifications produce parametrically scale-separated AdS3 vacua preserving extended supersymmetry, with a consistent three-dimensional N=2 effective description?

sources.title: Broken and restored: a holographic constraint for AdS vacua with orbifolds

evidence.text: Do integer-spectrum type-II AdS compactifications satisfy the proposed holographic constraint on extremal and super-extremal cubic couplings, and can changes of orbifold geometry remove violations and reveal restrictions on orientifold configurations?

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Can localized O6 sources preserve the controlled, stabilized, scale-separated AdS physics obtained from smeared type IIA Calabi-Yau orientifold solutions?

sources.title: Warped $\hbox {G}_2$-throats in IIA and uplift dSillusions

evidence.text: Can flux-stabilized CGLP-type warped throats inside compact G2 spaces provide consistent anti-D2 uplifts of scale-separated AdS3 vacua to metastable dS3, either from classical massive IIA vacua or hypothetical quantum-stabilized no-scale vacua?

sources.title: T-dualities and scale-separated AdS$_3$ in massless IIA on $(X_6 \times S^1)/\mathbb{Z}_2$

evidence.text: Can G2-derived AdS3 flux vacua be mapped to geometric, scale-separated massless IIA backgrounds with only net O6 contributions, including a large-radius, strong-coupling regime suitable for a possible eleven-dimensional uplift?

sources.title: Scale-separated AdS$_2$ flux vacua from type II

evidence.text: Can type II compactifications produce controlled AdS2 vacua with every internal KK scale parametrically above the curvature scale, and how does this geometric hierarchy coexist with a proposed supersymmetric domain-wall obstruction?

sources.title: O6-plane backreaction on scale-separated Type IIA AdS$_{3}$ vacua

evidence.text: Does replacing smeared O6-planes by localized sources spoil the previously constructed scale-separated massive type IIA AdS3 vacua, or are the resulting field and effective-potential corrections parametrically controlled?

destination.title: Vacuum energy, gravitational response and cosmological evolution
destination.question: How is vacuum energy defined and coupled to gravity, what could explain its smallness or evolution, and what constraints follow for cosmology and microscopic physics?
destination.summary: A navigational family spanning the cosmological constant problem, adjustment and selection mechanisms, evolving vacuum models, compactification, stability and gravitational tests. Its branches retain different targets, dimensions, assumptions and evidential status.

systems: Scalar, moduli, axion and flux models
targets: Definition and small gravitational effect of vacuum energy
regimes: Flat-space and curved-space calculations remain distinct
Classical, semiclassical and conjectural quantum-gravity descriptions
assumptions: Mechanism-specific assumptions apply only to their source questions
Quantum-gravity conjectures and environmental measures are conditional inputs
Numerical membership is retrieval provenance, not scientific agreement
conventions: Preserve each source's distinction between vacuum-energy density and curvature cosmological constant
Preserve regulator, matching, Planck-unit and compactification conventions
includes: Historical and pedagogical context with dated observational claims
Critiques and unsuccessful or incomplete proposals
Method and application overlaps identified as such
excludes: An assertion that all sources ask one scoped question
Generic quantum-state or oscillon dynamics as explanations of the cosmological constant
Treating a running coefficient, a probability peak or a discrete spectrum as a demonstrated stable observed vacuum

sources.title: Thermal derivation of the Coleman-De Luccia tunneling prescription

evidence.text: Isolate the effects of curvature and a cosmological horizon on vacuum decay while suppressing the response of the metric. A positive common vacuum-energy scale fixes Λ, while the much smaller variation of V supplies the transition barrier.

sources.title: O'KKLT at finite temperature

evidence.text: Does varying one coupling at fixed others miss theories with similar vacuum structure? Selected de Sitter parameter examples motivate considering coordinated changes.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: How can quantum vacuum energy be compared with spacetime curvature and cosmological observations? The lecture uses semiclassical general relativity and changes its numerical Planck normalization before discussing flux relaxation.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Can a quantized flux discharge cancel a generic negative vacuum contribution? The single-field model makes the vacuum density adjustable through membrane transitions while keeping the bare contribution and charge fixed.

sources.title: Decoupling Inflation From the String Scale

evidence.text: How small must the gravitational coupling of negative Casimir energy be for compact hyperbolic pre-inflation to preserve an assumed initial homogeneity through chaotic mixing, while avoiding the analyzed Seiberg–Witten brane-production instability?

sources.title: A geometric solution to the coincidence problem, and the size of the landscape as the origin of hierarchy

evidence.text: Can the causal patch measure explain the coincidence between observer time and vacuum domination without requiring galaxies or entropy production, and relate their enormous common scale to the effective number of landscape vacua?

sources.title: The Cosmological Constant and Lorentz Invariance of the Vacuum State

evidence.text: Can requiring a Lorentz-invariant vacuum remove the power-divergent contributions used in conventional cosmological-constant estimates, reduce the remaining fine-tuning, and stabilize the gravitational hierarchy?

sources.title: Lectures on the Cosmological Constant Problem

evidence.text: How can the measured cosmological constant remain stable under higher-loop corrections and changes of effective description? The lectures distinguish achieving radiative stability from predicting its numerical value.

sources.title: Cosmological bounds on TeV-scale physics and beyond

evidence.text: Can connected vacuum stress-energy fluctuations source observable cosmological metric correlations and constrain ultraviolet physics independently of the vacuum expectation value?

sources.title: Quantum Cosmology Near Two Dimensions

evidence.text: How does anomalous gravitational dressing of the cosmological-constant operator modify semiclassical gravitational dynamics near two dimensions, and can its cosmological consequences suggest mechanisms for vacuum-energy decay, inflation and dark energy?

sources.title: Relaxing the Cosmological Constant: a Proof of Concept

evidence.text: Can classical, technically natural dynamics relax an initially large positive cosmological constant to a parameter-selected small value, then generate an inflationary and reheated universe without reopening a landscape of dark-energy values?

sources.title: Linking Light Scalar Modes with A Small Positive Cosmological Constant in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a statistical preference for very small positive physical vacuum energy in the string landscape also account for very light scalars and axions, while surviving quantum corrections?

sources.title: Cosmology and the Fate of Dilatation Symmetry

evidence.text: Under what conditions can dilatation symmetry, or its anomaly acting on a dynamical Planck scale, yield realistic late cosmology and a vanishing cosmological constant?

sources.title: Why the cosmological constant is so small: A string theory perspective

evidence.text: Can dynamical flux-vacuum statistics explain an exponentially small positive cosmological constant without parameter fine-tuning, remain stable statistically under quantum corrections, and also favor light scalar masses?

sources.title: A new light on the darkest corner of the landscape

evidence.text: Can corrections to the classical axionic flat direction produce a fully stabilized positive vacuum or a slowly evolving accelerating cosmology?

sources.title: Scalar Field Theory Description of the Running Vacuum Model: the Vacuumon

evidence.text: Can the running vacuum model (RVM) be represented by a classical scalar field during early inflation and late acceleration, and what physical information survives a formal comparison with scalaron inflation or effective dark-energy fields?

sources.title: Higgs potential near-criticality from a de Sitter swampland-like condition

evidence.text: What vacuum geometries can support positive false-vacuum energy under the proposed condition? The paper treats an unequal two-minimum scalar model and a separate reflection-symmetric construction.

sources.title: Relaxation of the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Can dynamical relaxation reduce a large positive cosmological constant to the meV vacuum-energy scale while reheating an otherwise emptied universe, and can additional sectors produce a positive final value and extend the initial scanning scale?

sources.title: Dark Horse, Dark Matter: Revisiting the $SO$(16)x $SO$(16)' Nonsupersymmetric Model in the LHC and Dark Energy Era

evidence.text: Can an additional potential stabilize the dilaton while retaining a positive reduced vacuum energy? The paper demonstrates this phenomenologically and asks whether condensates or Casimir effects can generate the required stabilization within the model.

sources.title: On the origin of the LIGO "mystery" noise and the high energy particle physics desert

evidence.text: Could metric fluctuations sourced by massive Standard Model vacuum stress account for the historically reported unattributed LIGO noise, and what would that interpretation imply for detector noise floors and heavier weakly coupled particles?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction and (Anti) de Sitter bounds

evidence.text: Does a small vacuum energy require an accompanying tower of light particles, and how does the mass exponent depend on spacetime dimension?

sources.title: Yoga Dark Energy: natural relaxation and other dark implications of a supersymmetric gravity sector

evidence.text: Can a relaxon, a very supersymmetric gravity sector and accidental approximate scale invariance jointly suppress the gravitational response of known-particle vacuum energies while producing viable dark energy? The target is explicitly the low-energy cosmological constant problem; UV completion remains open.

sources.title: Renormalizing the vacuum energy in cosmological spacetime: implications for the cosmological constant problem

evidence.text: Can renormalizing scalar-field vacuum energy in cosmological spacetime avoid quartic-mass fine-tuning while yielding controlled vacuum dynamics, an equation of state, inflation and gravitational running?

sources.title: Quantum-mechanical mechanism for reducing the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can quantum membrane nucleation dynamically relax an arbitrary matter-sector vacuum energy toward Λ→0⁺, suppress further discharge near Minkowski space, and permit ordinary cosmology without anthropic selection?

sources.title: Dark dimension, the swampland, and the origin of cosmic rays beyond the Greisen-Zatsepin-Kuzmin barrier

evidence.text: The small observed vacuum energy supplies the infrared hierarchy that the dark-dimension proposal attempts to relate to a tower of light states and a much lower gravitational cutoff.

sources.title: Radiative stability of tiny cosmological constant from the swampland and quantized compactification

evidence.text: Which known symmetry assumptions could protect vacuum energy, and why do they leave the problem open in the setting considered here?

sources.title: Does the vacuum gravitate on microscopic scales? Rydberg atoms indicate probably not

evidence.text: Can precision Rydberg spectroscopy constrain the gravitating component of vacuum energy at microscopic distances, including scenarios in which its gravitational effects depend on distance?

sources.title: The cosmological constant is probably still zero

evidence.text: Can membrane nucleation in four-form landscapes select a near-Minkowski vacuum probabilistically, through its longevity, while admitting sufficiently dense vacuum energies and avoiding the empty-universe problem?

sources.title: Perils of towers in the swamp: dark dimensions and the robustness of EFTs

evidence.text: Do suppressed vacuum energies from infinite towers reveal an unexpected failure of EFT reasoning, and can large extra dimensions explain dark energy once ultraviolet sensitivity and brane backreaction are included?

sources.title: de Sitter space decay and cosmological constant relaxation in unimodular gravity with charged membranes

evidence.text: Can generalized covariant unimodular gravity be identified with 4-form theories, and can charged-membrane nucleation dynamically favor an arbitrarily small positive cosmological constant without anthropic selection?

sources.title: Thermal derivation of the Coleman-De Luccia tunneling prescription

evidence.text: Optimize a fixed-energy escape path, convert it into a Euclidean trajectory, and extract its exit turning configuration. In a field theory the optimization takes place over spatial configurations, including gradient energy, rather than over homogeneous field values alone.

sources.title: O'KKLT at finite temperature

evidence.text: Compute background-dependent masses, expand their one-loop thermal functions for masses much smaller than temperature, and retain T². Remove the field-independent radiation term only when taking field derivatives.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Approximate a thin energy shell by its continuum volume and compare that volume with a lattice cell. The operation estimates configuration abundance, with arithmetic and degeneracy checks needed for claims about actual nearby energy levels.

sources.title: Decoupling Inflation From the String Scale

evidence.text: Solve the Casimir-modified Friedmann equation and express conformal time through elliptic integrals. The future conformal extent is τ∞(α)=K(√[(1+α²)/(1+2α²)])/√(1+2α²). Compare this height with a width estimated from the maximal injectivity radius.

sources.title: A geometric solution to the coincidence problem, and the size of the landscape as the origin of hierarchy

evidence.text: Solve the Friedmann evolution piecewise, integrate χ_CP(t)=∫ₜ∞dt′/a(t′), and obtain causal-patch matter mass M_CP=t_c V_com(χ_CP). Hyperbolic volume growth converts the geometric cutoff into powers and exponentials of the timescales.

sources.title: The Cosmological Constant and Lorentz Invariance of the Vacuum State

evidence.text: Compute vacuum energy and pressure with a spatial momentum cutoff, compare their quartic, quadratic and logarithmic terms, and subtract Lorentz-violating terms using local counterterms. Introduce a scale μ for logarithmic subtraction and remove the cutoff.

sources.title: Dynamical tadpoles and Weak Gravity Constraints

evidence.text: Can a quantum-gravity bound expose artificial removal of a source that should drive spacetime evolution? The proposed test follows charged objects away from a supersymmetric vacuum while examining the modified background equations.

sources.title: Old Ideas for New Physicists III: String Theory Parameters are NOT Vacuum Expectation Values

evidence.text: Why is it misleading to classify asymptotic field values labeling string/QG models as quantum-field-theory vacuum expectation values, and what distinguishes genuine VEVs from data defining a quantum model?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: What principle, dynamics, boundary condition, or environmental selection explains a total vacuum density many orders below its estimated field-theory contributions? Any proposed explanation must also permit the observed matter, radiation, and cosmic history.

sources.title: dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a landscape account for a very small cosmological constant without calculating each vacuum energy to the observed precision?

sources.title: The cosmological constant problem: from Newtonian cosmology to the greatest puzzle of modern theoretical cosmology

evidence.text: How does the cosmological constant connect Newtonian cosmology, relativistic expansion and quantum vacuum energy, and why does its cosmologically inferred value pose a renormalization and naturalness problem?

sources.title: Thermodynamic formulation of vacuum energy density in flat spacetime and potential implications for the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can high-temperature thermodynamics provide a consistent nonperturbative prescription for flat-space vacuum energy, and what could this imply for a conditional formulation of the cosmological constant problem?

sources.title: Beauty is attractive: Moduli trapping at enhanced symmetry points

evidence.text: Can quantum production of particles becoming light near special moduli-space loci trap rolling moduli, and thereby influence vacuum selection, the cosmological moduli problem, and acceleration on steep potentials?

sources.title: Holography and variable cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can a holographically constrained vacuum energy with a cosmological infrared cutoff describe a variable, true cosmological constant while respecting gravitational conservation identities and the observational requirements discussed in the paper?

sources.title: Dark dimension and the effective field theory limit

evidence.text: Can the Dark Dimension relation Λcc ∼ mKK^4 consistently match the vacuum energy of its low-energy EFT, and do the objections to the authors’ earlier cutoff-dependent calculation resolve that matching problem?

sources.title: Wilsonian Effective Field Theory and String Theory

evidence.text: Does the sign of a string-derived ultraviolet vacuum energy constrain the sign of the cosmological vacuum energy after integrating all lower-energy fluctuations? The question requires specified matching data, particle thresholds and a distinction between a running coupling and the full effective potential.

sources.title: On likely values of the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Does anthropic selection explain a small effective vacuum energy and the coincidence of galaxy formation with vacuum domination when the prior is derived from a specific cosmological model rather than assumed flat?

sources.title: Does the cosmological constant really indicate the existence of a dark dimension?

evidence.text: Does a consistently regulated higher-dimensional EFT automatically yield vacuum energy proportional to m_KK^4, as invoked in the dark dimension proposal, or do additional UV-sensitive terms obstruct matching to the swampland relation?

sources.title: Quantum Cosmology in Four Dimensions

evidence.text: How do anomalous gravitational dressings in a proposed four-dimensional nonlocal effective action modify homogeneous cosmology, and can the resulting vacuum-energy decay drive slow-roll expansion without an inflaton?

sources.title: The Cosmological Constant Problem: Why it's hard to get Dark Energy from Micro-physics

evidence.text: Why does quantum vacuum energy produce so little observed curvature, and can its small gravitational effect be technically natural? The focus is the old cosmological constant problem, distinguished from explaining the observed nonzero value or cosmic coincidence.

sources.title: Dark energy in quantum field theory: Implications on modern cosmology

evidence.text: Can renormalized quantum matter fluctuations in an expanding universe support dynamical vacuum energy, and can Brans–Dicke and running-vacuum cosmologies alleviate the H0 and σ8 tensions?

sources.title: Radiative stability of tiny cosmological constant from the swampland and quantized compactification

evidence.text: Can a discrete relation among a vacuum parameter, a compactification radius, and light-spectrum data protect the smallness of vacuum energy?

sources.title: Quantum vacuum energy as the origin of gravity

evidence.text: Can flat-space quantum vacuum energy generate gravity, determine Newton’s constant environmentally, and produce cosmological evolution that addresses the Hubble tension and avoids a=0?

sources.title: Running vacuum in quantum field theory in curved spacetime: renormalizing $\rho_{vac}$ without $\sim m^4$ terms

evidence.text: Can a direct renormalized QFT calculation in spatially flat FLRW spacetime yield running-vacuum dynamics while removing quartic mass contributions from relations between vacuum energy densities at different scales?

sources.title: The cosmological constant and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can membrane nucleation dynamically halt cosmological-constant discharge near Minkowski space while respecting the membrane weak gravity conjecture, and how are the resulting long-lived vacua populated?

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Does ultraviolet quantum gravity select the theta boundary condition, or must all fixed-theta vacua be considered? The paper assumes the latter, making possible positive-energy members of the theta family part of its motivation for a dynamical field.

sources.title: The distribution of vacua in random landscape potentials

evidence.text: How frequently do minima of a many-field random potential have positive vacuum energy, and how curved are their softest directions? The target is an ensemble count of minima, with observer selection and cosmological population dynamics outside the calculation.

sources.title: The Cosmological Constant and the String Landscape

evidence.text: Which principles constrain fixed and adjustable cosmological-constant proposals, and how credible and predictive is the string landscape as an environmental explanation? The principal focus is why vacuum energy is not large, rather than the full dark-energy problem.

sources.title: Cosmological constant: The Weight of the vacuum

evidence.text: Why is gravitational vacuum energy so small, with positive ΛL_P² ≈ 10^-123, and why is its density comparable to matter today? What can cosmological observations establish about its nature?

sources.title: The Cosmological constant problem and quintessence

evidence.text: Why is vacuum energy so small, can dynamical dark energy reduce fine tuning or cosmic coincidence, and how can observations distinguish a cosmological constant from evolving quintessence?

sources.title: Conditions for (No) Eternal Inflation

evidence.text: Could a vacuum-decay condition help explain why observers live near the onset of dark-energy domination?

sources.title: On the cosmological constant, the KK mass scale, and the cut-off dependence in the dark dimension scenario

evidence.text: Do cutoff-dependent EFT vacuum-energy calculations invalidate the dark dimension relation between the cosmological constant and the KK mass scale, or can an appropriate treatment of radius and cutoff recover the proposed scaling?

sources.title: Towards a unified quantum field theory of dark energy and inflation: unstable de Sitter vacuum and running vacuum

evidence.text: Can renormalized matter-field vacuum fluctuations connect primordial inflation, decay into FLRW radiation, and late dynamical dark energy within one semiclassical framework? The paper studies initially exact de Sitter space and compares its predictions with the reviewed running vacuum model (RVM).

sources.title: Stress-energy tensor of a scalar field on a product spacetime with a time-dependent compact dimension

evidence.text: How can one calculate vacuum scalar stress-energy, including time-dependent Casimir energy and pressures, on FLRW × S¹ when exact modes are unavailable, and what consistency tests support a modified adiabatic prescription?

sources.title: Casimir energy stabilization of Standard Model landscape in dark dimension

evidence.text: Can Casimir contributions from light bulk fields stabilize a micron-scale fifth dimension with positive four-dimensional vacuum energy compatible with the observed value, while addressing the radion force and chirality problems?

sources.title: The dark dimension and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the small observed vacuum-energy density identify an asymptotic quantum-gravity regime and thereby correlate infrared particle scales, extra-dimensional geometry, and the ultraviolet cutoff?

sources.title: Could LIV/noncommutativity alleviate the cosmological constant problem?

evidence.text: Can Lorentz-invariance violation or noncommutative spacetime models soften the ultraviolet behavior of scalar vacuum energy enough to mitigate the cosmological constant problem?

sources.title: Radiative stability of tiny cosmological constant from the swampland and quantized compactification

evidence.text: Can a tiny positive vacuum-energy density remain stable against quantum and nonperturbative contributions? The paper seeks a restriction arising from compactification that could replace the otherwise highly precise cancellation between bare vacuum energy and radiative corrections.

sources.title: Implications of the weak gravity conjecture for de Sitter space decay by flux discharge

evidence.text: How do membrane weak-gravity bounds, natural vacuum energy and effective-theory cutoffs constrain cosmological-constant relaxation by flux discharge, and under what conditions can the dynamics favor small positive Λ without anthropic selection?

sources.title: Dark Energy and the Symbiosis Between Micro-physics and Cosmology (Naturally)

evidence.text: How can EFT consistency and technical naturalness constrain explanations of dark energy, and can approximate scaling, supersymmetric extra dimensions, and relaxation connect its small density to microphysics?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation in Swampy Landscapes

evidence.text: Can a flat-prior anthropic prediction of the cosmological constant survive strong dynamical differences between vacua?

sources.title: The cosmological constant, dark matter and the electroweak scale meet in the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a warped Dark Dimension and a further application of Distance-Conjecture-inspired reasoning connect the cosmological constant to the electroweak scale, while addressing Standard Model contributions to vacuum energy?

sources.title: The Cosmological constant

evidence.text: Pedagogical review of how a cosmological constant affects cosmology, what observations then constrained its magnitude, and why a small, possibly nonzero vacuum energy challenges fundamental physics.

sources.title: Quantization of four form fluxes and dynamical neutralization of the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can quantized four-form fluxes densely scan the cosmological constant and dynamically produce small-vacuum-energy regions with reheating and sufficiently long lifetimes?

sources.title: String-Inspired Running Vacuum—The “Vacuumon”—And the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Does satisfying conjectured quantum-gravity constraints make the vacuumon a faithful quantum description of running-vacuum inflation? The paper compares potential tests with the distinct dynamics of a gravitational-wave condensate and Kalb-Ramond axion.

sources.title: The Swampland, Quintessence and the Vacuum Energy

evidence.text: Can cosmological variation of particle masses or couplings coexist with a quintessence potential of dark-energy size once quantum vacuum-energy corrections are included?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: What minimal field dynamics can keep the universe approximately vacuum dominated and later allow the field to evolve away?

sources.title: Time varying alpha and particle physics

evidence.text: Can a cosmic scalar produce the historically suggested fractional change δα/α≈10−4 without radiatively generating a vacuum-energy variation incompatible with standard cosmology or requiring extraordinary fine tuning?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Could a tiny observed vacuum density reflect environmental selection among many possible densities? The proposal conditions observations on habitable regions rather than requiring a dynamical law that cancels vacuum energy everywhere.

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: Can a tiny energy generated in a second phase explain the observed positive vacuum energy of the physical phase?

sources.title: Comment on the Vacuum Energy Density for λϕ$^{4}$ Theory in d Spacetime Dimensions

evidence.text: Can a weak-coupling, zero-temperature calculation without integrability motivate ρvac=−mᵈ/(2g) for interacting scalar theories, including positive vacuum energy without spontaneous symmetry breaking, and determine its proposed RG evolution?

sources.title: Everything You Always Wanted To Know About The Cosmological Constant Problem (But Were Afraid To Ask)

evidence.text: How should classical and quantum vacuum contributions to the cosmological constant be defined and renormalized, and why does a discrepancy with gravitational observations remain after divergences are removed?

sources.title: The History of the cosmological constant problem

evidence.text: How did the cosmological term evolve from Einstein's 1917 construction into a quantum vacuum-energy problem, and which historical motivations, observational episodes and early quantum arguments shaped that transition?

sources.title: Confinement from distance in metric space and its relation to cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can dependence of gauge kinetic functions on distance between metric configurations relate confinement scales to the cosmological constant, and provide a conditional mechanism for preserving the Festina Lente confinement bound as de Sitter vacuum energy increases?

sources.title: Why The Cosmological Constant is a Boundary Condition

evidence.text: Why should the cosmological constant be treated as an infrared boundary condition defining a quantum-gravity model, and where does the conventional bulk vacuum-energy calculation exceed the validity of quantum field theory?
